profile.headline: Senior .NET Developer | C# · ASP.NET Core · REST APIs · Azure | 15+ Years Building Scalable Backend & Enterprise Solutions | Open to Work
profile.summary: I'm a senior software developer with 15+ years of experience building high-volume APIs, enterprise applications, and data integration systems in C# and .NET Core. Most recently at Ascendum/Fidelity Investments, I've designed brokerage and retirement platform APIs serving millions of transactions and integrated AI-assisted development using GitHub Copilot. I thrive in Agile environments and have delivered across financial services, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing. Currently exploring my next senior or lead backend engineering role.
